Voloder Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Voloder, Croatia

Demolished. Voloder, first recorded on a 1773 map as 'Dorf Voloder,' briefly came under French rule before joining the Habsburg Empire; the region was known for agricultural production. This cemetery, established in 1860 and used only until 1873, also served the Jewish community of Kutina, documented elsewhere in this collection. According to local testimony gathered by ESJF surveyors, a barn was later built over part of the site, and a neighboring farmer once plowed into cemetery remains before being told to stop; nothing else is known about Voloder's local Jewish community.
